prompts.galata-sykai: Use case: historical-scene. Single small companion city sprite for historical atlas circa1180. Original Acre reference is STYLE ONLY: fine ink outlines, muted warm masonry, terracotta roofs, compact irregular varied buildings, restrained watercolor shading. Do not copy Acre layout or Crusader flags. Transparent background with clean silhouette, no haze/sky/frame/labels/text, no large landscape; fully enclosed cutout with generous transparent padding. Architectural details and street plan must be restrained schematic approximations, not fantasy grandeur. No Ottoman mosques/minarets, modern buildings, bridges, later Genoese towers, heraldry or flags. Oblique isometric viewpoint matching reference, readable at256 atlas pixels. Narrow water fringe at shore only. Subject: Byzantine Galata/Sykai on northern shore of Golden Horn, BEFORE Genoese colony. Modest open waterfront settlement climbing gently behind a compact squat rectangular masonry chain-fort at water's edge, sturdy square tower and low attached fort buildings. Small landing with two modest wooden boats, tiny length of heavy chain coiled or attached INSIDE shore fort, no long detached chain across canvas. A handful of varied houses, a small understated Byzantine church, gardens and open ground. Fort is the earlier waterfront Kastellion, NOT tall cylindrical hilltop Galata Tower. No enormous ring of city walls, no Gothic commercial palaces, no massive port basin. Land continues behind sprite, not an island.
